description: Deterministic denominator rules for required workflow events.

rules.legacy_confidence_rule: Legacy rows count as exact only when source and agent identity are explicit; otherwise mark unknown.
rules.denominator_effect: Add one expected invocation-start event for each observed spawn transition.

rules.allowed_window: until session termination or explicit abandonment
rules.legacy_confidence_rule: Legacy invocation rows without a terminal marker are unknown, not successful.
rules.denominator_effect: Add one expected invocation-finished event for each observed invocation start.

rules.legacy_confidence_rule: Legacy parent notifications without a transport outcome are unknown.
rules.denominator_effect: Add one expected delivery attempt for each observed parent notification.

rules.allowed_window: until inbox expiration, abandonment, or session termination
rules.legacy_confidence_rule: Legacy delivery rows without an inbox consumer are unknown.
rules.denominator_effect: Add one expected consumption observation for each durable delivery attempt.

rules.allowed_window: until acceptance, explicit abandonment, cancellation, or session termination
rules.legacy_confidence_rule: A durable guidance enqueue without same-batch acceptance or explicit abandonment remains pending or unknown; a transport write alone is not success.
rules.denominator_effect: Add one expected terminal guidance outcome for each observed durable enqueue.

rules.allowed_window: until gate opening, terminal phase, or session termination
rules.legacy_confidence_rule: A parked slice without a gate opening or terminal run outcome is unknown, not safely parked.
rules.denominator_effect: Add one expected gate-opening or terminal-outcome observation for each observed slice park.

rules.allowed_window: until answer, cancellation, or session termination
rules.legacy_confidence_rule: An opened human gate without an answer remains pending or unknown; elapsed time is part of the denominator.
rules.denominator_effect: Add one expected gate answer for each observed gate opening and measure answer latency until resolution.

rules.legacy_confidence_rule: Legacy PR rows without watcher identity remain unknown.
rules.denominator_effect: Add one expected PR observation for each eligible published PR.

rules.legacy_confidence_rule: A published PR without a review carrying the same PR and verified head is unknown, not reviewed.
rules.denominator_effect: Add one expected current-head review observation for each published PR.

rules.legacy_confidence_rule: A head update without a CI status carrying the same PR and verified head is unknown, not green.
rules.denominator_effect: Add one expected current-head CI observation for each PR head update.

rules.allowed_window: until merge outcome, cancellation, or session termination
rules.legacy_confidence_rule: A merge request without an approved review for the exact requested head is unknown and unsafe.
rules.denominator_effect: Add one expected exact-head approval for each merge request.

rules.allowed_window: until merge outcome, cancellation, or session termination
rules.legacy_confidence_rule: A merge request without passing CI for the exact requested head is unknown and unsafe.
rules.denominator_effect: Add one expected passing exact-head CI observation for each merge request.

rules.allowed_window: until merge failure, cancellation, or session termination
rules.legacy_confidence_rule: A legacy merge request without an explicit outcome is unknown.
rules.denominator_effect: Add one expected merge outcome for each observed merge request.
